text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAHHHH!!)

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa...! How's that... did you see 
that...!

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text: Scarlett! Look over here!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Yes! I'll answer with my best 
smile♪
choice_data_list: You're getting a lot of eyes on you, huh?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Ha, of course. Who else would you look at 
besides me?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"...Well then, all that's left is the 
concert. *Sigh*, I'm still feeling pretty 
tired, though."
choice_data_list: Because everyone is waiting for you.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, of course you did. I completely 
stole the spotlight in today's race, after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Just so you know, though, I'm not 
satisfied yet, okay?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"The '#1' I'm aiming for isn't something 
that can be satisfied with just this."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Beyond this autumn, beyond the winter. 
Even as I move from the Classic class to 
the Senior class. These feelings will 
never change."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
For example, next spring's Osaka Hai. Even 
if it's the first Senior-class 
medium-distance GⅠ, I'll shine brighter 
than anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Fufun. I won't let it stay just a goal. 
Making it reality is what makes me who I 
am!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, did you record 
today's run? As soon as we get back, we 
should analyze—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
*sigh* Spoken like a true perfectionist 
honor student.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Vodka!? What are you doing here? How are 
you feeling...?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I just can't run, that's all. Goin' 
outside ain't a problem.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Still... well, how should I put it. 
Scarlet, your running today was...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...How was my running?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Heh, she was like this! "*Haa*... *haa*... 
I can't take it anymore~"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Haaah?! Are you stupid or what?! Quit 
making up wild stories!

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, Daiwa Scarlet! It's about time 
to get ready for the concert—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Ah, yes! I'm on my way!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph, you hurry up and go home too! 
This isn't your waiting room, you know!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah, I get it, I get it.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"...What's wrong with me? Coming all this 
way and choking up... That's just 
pathetic."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
It was just a few words. ..."You were so 
cool."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"...Whoa-agh! Shoot, I forgot you were 
here!!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Daaah, dammit! See ya! And don't you dare 
tell him, got it?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And with that, Vodka ran off.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...I decide to keep her mutterings a 
secret."
